sanskrit_verse:
भगास्थि एकं तथा पृष्ठे चत्वारिंशच् च पञ्च च ।
ग्रीवा पञ्चदशास्थिः स्याज् जत्र्व् एकैकं तथा हनुः ॥
transliteration: bhagāsti ekaṃ tathā pṛṣṭhe catvāriṃśac ca pañca ca | grīvā pañcadaśāstiḥ syāj jatru ekaikaṃ tathā hanuḥ ||
sph_interpretive_translation: The sacrum consists of one bone; the dorsal region contains forty-five bones including five additional ones; the neck comprises fifteen vertebrae; each shoulder blade and jawbone counts as singular.
